extractCases.name: fixture-opaque: extract 'plain' via real AtlasDocument.parse path (exact, binary alpha)
fixture-opaque: extract 'withOffsets' via real AtlasDocument.parse path (exact, binary alpha)
fixture-opaque: extract 'dupeA' via real AtlasDocument.parse path (exact, binary alpha)
fixture-opaque: extract 'dupeB' via real AtlasDocument.parse path (exact, binary alpha)
fixture-tie: extract 'tieRegion' via real path, scale=1.5 forces roundHalfEven .5-tie (orig_w/orig_h 7*1.5=10.5 -> 10, even-floor tie; Math.round would give 11)
extractRegionFromPage: default offsets (offsets=None) returns the bare crop, no padding canvas
